tagline: Web design, built for what's next.
heroTitle: Websites engineered to move your business forward.
heroSubtitle: I design and build fast, modern, custom websites — then keep them running smoothly. Design, development, and bug-fixing, all under one roof.
aboutText: I'm a web designer focused on building fast, modern, custom websites for small businesses and ambitious brands. Full bio coming soon — for now, reach out and let's talk about your project.
whatsappMessage: Hi! I'd like to talk about a website project.

services.title: Website Design
services.description: Custom, on-brand designs built from scratch — no generic templates. Every layout is designed around your business and your customers.

services.title: Website Development
services.description: Fast, responsive, production-ready builds using modern tools, from simple presentation sites to fully custom, animated experiences.

services.title: Redesigns & Refreshes
services.description: Got a site that feels outdated or isn't converting? I'll rebuild it with a modern look, better structure, and improved performance.

services.title: Bug Fixes & Troubleshooting
services.description: Broken layouts, form issues, slow load times, weird bugs — I dig in, find the root cause, and fix it properly.

services.title: Ongoing Maintenance
services.description: Updates, small changes, monitoring, and quick turnarounds so your site keeps running smoothly long after launch.

services.title: Let's figure it out together
services.description: Not sure exactly what you need? If it's design-related, chances are we can work it out together — get in touch and let's talk.

processSteps.title: Discovery call
processSteps.description: A short, free conversation about your business, your goals, and what the site needs to do — no obligation.

processSteps.title: Proposal & price
processSteps.description: You get a clear scope and a fixed price before any work starts — no surprises later.

processSteps.title: Design & development
processSteps.description: I design and build the site, sharing progress along the way so you can give feedback early.

processSteps.title: Launch & support
processSteps.description: We go live together, and I stay available for fixes, tweaks, and questions afterward.

faq.question: How long does a typical project take?
faq.answer: Anywhere from 2 to 8 weeks depending on the package and scope — Spark projects are usually fastest, Nova projects take longer given the custom work involved.

faq.question: What happens if I need changes after launch?
faq.answer: Small fixes and tweaks are covered for a short period after launch. For ongoing changes, I offer a simple maintenance arrangement — ask when we talk.

faq.question: Do you work with clients outside your country?
faq.answer: Yes — most of the process happens over calls and messages, so location isn't a barrier.

faq.question: Do I need to have my content and images ready?
faq.answer: It helps, but it's not required — I can work with placeholder content and swap it in later, or help you figure out what you need.

faq.question: What if I'm not sure which package fits my project?
faq.answer: That's completely normal — get in touch and we'll figure out the right scope together before any commitment.
